name: prompt_for_language_selection
description: Asks the user to select their preferred language for communication with the chatbot.

parameters.name: selected_language
parameters.description: The preferred language the user wishes to communicate in.

children.name: prompt_for_privacy_policy_acceptance
children.description: Requests the user to accept or decline the privacy policy to proceed with assistance.

parameters.name: privacy_policy_acceptance
parameters.description: The user's decision to accept or decline the privacy policy.

children.name: prompt_for_age_group_selection
children.description: Requests the user to select their age group in order to provide tailored fare recommendations.

parameters.name: age_group
parameters.description: The age group of the user for fare calculation and relevant recommendations, represented in various formats.

children.name: provide_fare_recommendations
children.description: Provides the user with recommended fare and tariff options based on their profile, including pricing details for various ticket types and tourist passes.

outputs.description: Details on pricing for various ticket options including single journeys (Billete sencillo combinado), 10-journey tickets (10 viajes combinado), and tourist passes (Título Turístico) with prices for different durations.

children.name: provide_fare_information
children.description: Shares information regarding fare rules and requirements based on the user's age group.

outputs.description: Details about fare policies related to various age groups.

children.name: prompt_for_user_type
children.description: Inquires whether the user is a visitor or a regular user of the Metro network to provide relevant fare recommendations.

parameters.name: user_type
parameters.description: The classification of the user's relationship with the Metro network, indicating if the user is a visitor or a regular metro user.

children.name: provide_fare_recommendations
children.description: Provides the user with recommended fare and tariff options based on their profile, including pricing details for various ticket types and tourist passes.

outputs.description: Details on pricing for various ticket options including single journeys (Billete sencillo combinado), 10-journey tickets (10 viajes combinado), and tourist passes (Título Turístico) with prices for different durations.

children.name: provide_combined_ticket_info
children.description: Provides details about the Combined Ticket, including its validity and usage conditions.

outputs.description: Information about the Combined Ticket, including its validity across different lines, usage requirements, qualities, and restrictions.

children.name: prompt_for_privacy_acceptance
children.description: Requests the user to accept the privacy policy to proceed with further assistance.

parameters.name: acceptance
parameters.description: user confirmation for acceptance of the privacy policy.

name: prompt_for_destination_zone_selection
description: Requests the user to specify the destination zone for their journey.

parameters.name: destination_zone
parameters.description: The zone to which the user intends to travel.

name: provide_network_status
description: Informs the user about the current network status, including any disruptions or incidents affecting subway or train lines.

outputs.description: Specific incidents affecting subway lines, including detailed information about Line 6 and Line 7, their impact on train circulation, duration, and alternative transportation options available.

name: prompt_for_general_inquiry
description: The chatbot asks the user to specify other questions or inquiries they may have.

name: provide_pet_transportation_policy
description: The chatbot informs the user about the policies regarding traveling with small pets on the subway.

outputs.description: Specific rules governing pet transport on the subway.

name: prompt_for_destination_station
description: Prompts the user for their destination station to provide directions.

parameters.name: destination_station
parameters.description: The station where the user is headed, or the name of the station the user is traveling to.

children.name: provide_route_information
children.description: The chatbot provides details about the route from the starting station to the destination station, including estimated duration, transfer information, and an interactive map link.

parameters.name: current_station
parameters.description: The starting station (e.g., Atocha); destination_station: The destination station (e.g., Chamartín)

outputs.description: Estimated duration of the journey along with information about any required transfers.
A link to an interactive map for journey visualization.

name: present_transport_card_options
description: Lists different transportation cards available and their respective details.

outputs.description: Information about the Public Transport Personal Card, Public Transport Multi Card, and others available on the network.

name: present_assistance_options
description: Presents the user with a comprehensive list of options and services available for assistance with transportation-related inquiries.

outputs.description: Options available for assistance include inquiries about upcoming trains, recommended fares, transport card information, directions to stations, network status, facility status, and other inquiries.

name: prompt_for_start_zone
description: Prompts the user to specify their starting zone for the journey.

parameters.name: departure_zone
parameters.description: The zone from which the user plans to start their journey.

name: prompt_for_inquiry_type
description: The chatbot asks the user to specify the type of inquiry they have from a provided list.

parameters.name: inquiry_type
parameters.description: The specific area the user wants assistance with.

name: provide_bicycle_transportation_information
description: The chatbot provides information about the rules and policies governing bicycle transportation on the subway.

outputs.description: Details about the rules for traveling with bicycles, including specific regulations for transport on the subway.

name: present_map_download_options
description: The chatbot offers different map download options to the user.

outputs.description: Available maps include schematic map and tourist map.

name: provide_map_download
description: The chatbot shares the schematic map of the metro upon request.

name: prompt_for_usage_regulation_info
description: The chatbot offers a link to the regulations that govern usage of the metro service.

outputs.description: Link to the regulations of the metro service.

name: prompt_for_fare_recommendation
description: The chatbot prompts the user for information needed to recommend the best fare option.

parameters.name: age_group
parameters.description: The user's age group for fare recommendation.

name: prompt_for_current_station
description: Requests the user to specify their current station to provide further assistance or train information.

parameters.name: current_station
parameters.description: The name of the station where the user is currently located.

outputs.description: link to or description of a map with the stations.

children.name: present_subway_line_options
children.description: Provides information on the available subway lines at the specified station and prompts the user for their selection.

parameters.name: selected_line
parameters.description: The train line the user wishes to inquire further about, including subway options.

outputs.description: Information about the selected line and its connections, including lines like Línea 4, Línea 5, and Línea 10.

children.name: provide_route_information
children.description: The chatbot provides details about the route from the starting station to the destination station, including estimated duration, transfer information, and an interactive map link.

parameters.name: current_station
parameters.description: The starting station (e.g., Atocha); destination_station: The destination station (e.g., Chamartín)

outputs.description: Estimated duration of the journey along with information about any required transfers.
A link to an interactive map for journey visualization.

children.name: list_train_lines
children.description: Displays the available train lines at the user's specified station and prompts for the selection of a specific line.

parameters.name: selected_line
parameters.description: Indicates which train line the user wants information about

outputs.description: Line 4, Line 5, Line 10. Lists the train lines that operate from the specified station.

children.name: provide_upcoming_trains_information
children.description: Provides information about upcoming trains for the selected line at the user's station, including destinations and arrival times.

parameters.name: selected_line
parameters.description: The line that the user wants to check upcoming trains for (e.g., 4, 5, or 10).

outputs.description: Lists the upcoming trains with their respective destinations, directions, and estimated arrival times.

name: provide_next_train_info
description: Displays information about the next trains arriving at the specified station, including line numbers, directions, and waiting/arrival times.

outputs.description: Details of the next trains arriving, including line numbers, directions, waiting times, and arrival times.
